_comment_threshold: Opportunity threshold = Black VAP share of enacted District 7 (the single Black opportunity district in the enacted AL plan). District 7 has 50.4% Black VAP, so 0.50 is the benchmark floor. The chain requires every proposed plan to preserve at least 1 district at or above this share where the Black party-of-choice (D) wins — matching what the enacted map already achieves. This is the correct single-election simplification of the Becker et al. group-control-factor approach: with one binary election outcome, the GC factor min(2k,1) reduces to a hard VAP floor, and we anchor that floor to the enacted plan rather than choosing it arbitrarily.

interesting_plans.description: One more Democratic seat than enacted AL plan (3D vs enacted 2D)
